author: Bob Okun
text: Believe the finger stick. My experience is the libre tend to be 10 to 20 lower than the finger stick.., on a good day. The sensor is great for trend. I do a preflight (pseudo calibration) every morning.  I operate like a smart pump. Very fast insulin only PRN  (as needed). In engineering terms it would be called closed loop control. Usually it's only 5 boluses a day.
